plugin.note: Ensure Slayer 33, combat level 45, and Firemaking 33, then light and equip a bug lantern (mandatory to deal damage). The best location is east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains in Varlamore, which has safespots and no poison hazards; the Karamja spot north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai also works but needs antipoison. Exploit the 50% fire weakness with fire spells, or use melee given the low defensive bonuses. Swarms are very accurate, so bring 40-50+ Defence gear and food such as lobsters, or keep Protect from Melee active. A cannon can speed up kills, but the bug lantern must stay equipped for it to damage the swarms.

mechanics: Harpie bug swarms require Slayer 33, combat level 45, and Firemaking 33 to be assigned; without 33 Firemaking the task cannot be given (Mod Ash confirmed all three checks remain in effect).

A lit bug lantern (needs Firemaking 33 to light) must be lit AND equipped to deal any damage; requiredItemName records this, but requiredItemId is left null as it is a damage-enabling worn item rather than a modelled RuneLite item gate.
Only Vannaka assigns this task; Chaeldar stopped assigning it on 8 May 2024 and Duradel on 10 September 2015.

Harpie Bug Swarm has 25 Hitpoints, max hit 6 (Crush), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 32.

Monster gained a 50% elemental weakness to fire spells on 25 June 2025; weakness.style is MAGIC with element FIRE to reflect the recommended fire-spell method, though melee also works given low defensive bonuses.
No task extension unlock exists for Harpie bug swarms.

methods.label: East of the Colossal Wyrm Remains
steps: Varlamore location east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains; several safespots and free of the poison hazards found on Karamja, so no antipoison is needed.
Building a quetzal landing site at Colossal Wyrm Remains gives a quick shortcut to an Auburnvale bank and a prayer altar at The Teomat; nearest fairy ring is AJP.
Recommended over the Karamja location for convenience and safety.

methods.label: North-east of Tai Bwo Wannai
steps: Karamja location north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring DKP); reachable via Tai Bwo Wannai teleport scroll or the Brimhaven boat.
Two safespots exist; a dwarf multicannon can be used, but the bug lantern must be equipped for the cannon to deal damage, and telegrab runes are needed to collect drops.
Bring antipoison due to other aggressive, poisonous creatures nearby; completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio enables the Tribal Statue to recharge prayer.
